definition: Results after exceptional items and share of profit or loss of associates and joint ventures, before the remaining group-level reconciliation to profit before tax.
location: PDF page 2 · consolidated segment information, section C
notes: ₹5,462.22 crore of inter-segment revenue is deducted from ₹2,04,100.77 crore to reach ₹1,98,638.55 crore income from operations. Finance costs outside Financial Services and unallocated income further change group profit. The group profit also includes an exceptional charge of ₹292.94 crore for the Labour Codes (new wage and labour rules in force from 21 November 2025), which raised retirement-benefit obligations for service already worked. Exceptional items are unusual one-time gains or costs shown on their own line. The filing does not say whether this charge sits inside a segment result or in the unallocated line. An associate is a company Mahindra part-owns without controlling it; a joint venture is a business run together with a partner. Mahindra adds its share of their profit to its own (the equity method). For Industrial Businesses and Consumer Services the result before this share was ₹1,725.61 crore, against ₹3,704.64 crore after it, so most of that segment’s result is share of associates and joint ventures.
insight: Automotive is the largest revenue and segment-result contributor. Farm Equipment is smaller by sales but remains a substantial earnings contributor.
